title: Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol, PortFast, and BPDU Guard
summary: Configure IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (Rapid PVST+), tune bridge priorities for deterministic root bridge election, and secure edge access switchports with PortFast and BPDU Guard.
learning_objectives: Explain the operation of Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) and how IEEE 802.1w Rapid PVST+ improves convergence speed over legacy 802.1D.
Configure and verify Rapid PVST+ mode across a redundant triangle topology of Cisco Catalyst 2960 switches.
Influence the root bridge election deterministically using the spanning-tree vlan priority command.
Identify spanning-tree port roles (Root, Designated, Alternate) and states (Forwarding, Blocking).
Configure edge access ports with Spanning Tree PortFast to eliminate listening and learning delays for host workstations.
Implement Spanning Tree BPDU Guard to protect edge switchports from rogue switch attachments and bridge loop injection.
Verify dynamic failover convergence when a primary trunk link fails and observe rapid port unblocking.
